Letâ€™s plan your trip â†—
Can I book a one-way drop taxi?

Yes. Choose one-way / drop, then your pickup city, destination and travel date. You do not need to plan a return trip.

How is round trip priced?

Round trip is â‚¹1 per km less than the one-way rate for the same car. Confirm the total fare, driver allowance, tolls, parking and any other applicable charges before accepting a trip.

Which locations do you cover?

We cover journeys across Tamil Nadu and popular nearby hill destinations such as Ooty, Kodaikanal and Munnar. You can enter any town or city, even if it is not listed in the suggestions. Availability is confirmed for your specific route.

How accurate are the â€œfromâ€ fares on route pages?

They are rough one-way sedan bases using â‚¹15/km Ã— a typical highway distance. Actual km, vehicle rate, driver bata, tolls, parking and night charges can change the total. Always confirm the final fare with our team.

How is my fare confirmed?

Your final quote depends on the route, vehicle and travel schedule. Confirm the total fare, driver allowance, tolls, parking and any other applicable charges with the booking team before accepting a trip.

Is my trip confirmed when I fill in the form?

No. The form prepares your trip details. A booking is confirmed only after the team agrees on availability, pickup details and the final fare with you. We usually reply on WhatsApp within about 15 minutes.
